item.description: The Artifact class is missing a 'dumps' attribute that is expected by the serialization logic. Tests fail with AttributeError: 'Artifact' object has no attribute 'dumps'.
item.contract: Add a 'dumps' attribute to the Artifact class that can be used for serializing artifact data, similar to how Parameter class handles 'dumps' attribute. This should be a callable that takes a Pydantic model and returns a serialized string representation.
item.acceptance: Tests in test_serialisers.py that are failing due to AttributeError: 'Artifact' object has no attribute 'dumps' should pass, specifically: test_artifact_dumping, test_artifact_byte_dumping, test_artifact_loading

item.description: The _get_dumper_function logic doesn't properly handle Artifact objects with dumps attribute. The function checks for dumps attribute but doesn't correctly utilize it for Artifact instances.
item.contract: Modify _get_dumper_function to properly check for and use the 'dumps' attribute on Artifact objects when it's present, similar to how it handles Parameter objects.
item.acceptance: Tests that were failing due to missing dumps attribute handling should pass, particularly around artifact serialization scenarios

item.description: There's an inconsistency in handling Artifact objects with 'loadb' attribute. The code attempts to access 'loadb' but doesn't ensure it's properly defined.
item.contract: Ensure that Artifact class properly supports 'loadb' attribute for byte loading, and update the handling logic to prevent TypeError when accessing non-existent attributes.
item.acceptance: Tests that were failing with TypeError: unsupported operand type(s) for /: 'PosixPath' and 'NoneType' should pass

item.description: Type checking logic in _save_annotated_return_outputs doesn't properly handle generic types like typing.Dict[str, str] vs dict.
item.contract: Improve type checking logic to properly validate that output values match their annotated types, especially for generic types like Dict and List.
item.acceptance: Tests that were failing with "The type of output ... does not match the annotated type" should pass
